verdict.rationale: Sift is a SaaS fraud-detection platform, so full data export and portability is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only documents sending data into Sift (Events, Decisions and Score APIs, plus historical backfill). Nothing describes a bulk export of account data, open export formats, or an offboarding path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
